Name: Hippo's Cliffside Falls Farm Cave - Updated for 1.6
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/nfUW6xU.png[/img][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]

Hippo's maps were some of the first map mods I played with and I absolutely love them. Their work is so creative and I was sad to see they lost a lot of their work on their home tech and decided to retire from modding, but they allowed us (very graciously I might add) to update their mods and adopt them so to speak, so this is the first of several I have been working on to update to 1.6 ! I should be releasing the others after some bugtesting.

You can see the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10759]here[/url]﻿ and permissions provided via their profile [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/acearohippo?gameId=1303]here[/url]﻿.

This farm cave is adorable and super customizable. Toggle things like the fences, paved areas, lights, dirt/grass and more! Supports recolors and should be compatible with most mods (unless that mod specifically changes the farm cave, obviously).

I updated certain things to make it compatible with 1.6 and tweaked just a few tiny items like giving it the new waterfalls and adding a minecart.

To install, simply extract and place in your mods folder. I highly recommend using Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) to easily adjust your config from the game's menus.

Happy farming!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RHabloO.png[/img]﻿

[/size][/font][/center][font=Georgia][size=3][center]Thank you to Acearohippo for their amazing mods like this one.

Thanks to all my friends who listen to me scope creep myself into these mod ideas.[/center][/size][/font][center][font=Georgia][size=3]
﻿[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/nY2cWBM.png[/img]

A few folks have asked and I now have a kofi if you feel like you’d like to contribute towards the mods and me and my kitties.

[i][color=#d0e0e3][url=https://ko-fi.com/wildflourmods]Ko-fi.com/wildflourmods[/url][/color][/i]

It's absolutely [u]not required ever[/u] to enjoy my mod which will always be free for all; but I thank each and
every one of you who has donated or will possibly in the future. <3[/size][/font][/center][font=Georgia][size=3]
